question: A bus covers the first 50 km of its journey in 40 minutes and covers the remaining 75 km in 40 minutes. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the bus?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance of the first part = 50 km

Time taken for the first part = 40 minutes

Distance of the second part = 75 km

Time taken for the second part = 40 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance travelled / Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 50 km + 75 km = 125 km

Total time = 40 minutes + 40 minutes = 80 minutes

Convert time from minutes to hours:

80 minutes = 80 / 60 hours = (4)/(3) hours

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

Average speed = 125 km / (4)/(3) hours

⇒ Average speed = (375)/(4) km/h

⇒ Average speed = 93.75 km/h

**The average speed of the bus is 93 (3)/(4) km/h.**
